# uiforagents

Version 0.1.5; manifest schema 1.0.0.

Agent-first vanilla UI kit: registry-shaped, copy-in HTML/CSS, zero runtime dependencies. The primary consumer is the AI agent building the UI; humans review and own the output.

## How to use

- Pick an item below; each line is enough to choose a component and a variant without opening other files.
- Copy the files from items/<name>/: markup + CSS, plus a script when behavior is js-inline.
- Wire theme tokens: themes/tokens.css, or your own stylesheet declaring the same roles.
- Validate: open the item's example page and diff the rendered tree against its fixture.aria.yml with Playwright's ariaSnapshot.

## Token vocabulary

Every token is a --uifa-* custom property declared per theme in themes/tokens.css. The base scale: --uifa-bg --uifa-surface --uifa-surface-2 --uifa-border --uifa-border-strong --uifa-text --uifa-text-muted --uifa-faint --uifa-accent --uifa-accent-soft --uifa-accent-fg --uifa-ok --uifa-ok-soft --uifa-ok-fg --uifa-warn --uifa-warn-soft --uifa-warn-fg --uifa-danger --uifa-danger-soft --uifa-danger-fg --uifa-scrim --uifa-radius-control --uifa-radius-surface --uifa-radius-pill --uifa-border-width --uifa-shadow-char --uifa-font-display --uifa-font-body --uifa-font-mono --uifa-text-base --uifa-space --uifa-duration --uifa-ease --uifa-corner-shape --uifa-noise.
Pairs read background -> foreground: --uifa-bg/--uifa-text, --uifa-surface/--uifa-text, --uifa-surface-2, --uifa-accent/--uifa-accent-fg plus --uifa-accent-soft, and the same shape for --uifa-ok, --uifa-warn, --uifa-danger; --uifa-text-muted and --uifa-faint grade emphasis; --uifa-scrim dims overlays; --uifa-border and --uifa-border-strong draw edges. Shape tiers: --uifa-radius-control, --uifa-radius-surface, --uifa-radius-pill, --uifa-border-width, --uifa-corner-shape. Depth: --uifa-shadow-char. Type: --uifa-font-display, --uifa-font-body, --uifa-font-mono, --uifa-text-base. Density: --uifa-space. Motion: --uifa-duration (durations derive via calc(): 1x feedback, 2x enter, 1.33x exit) and --uifa-ease. Texture: --uifa-noise.
Components read tokens only - no component-local colors. Variants are closed [data-uifa-variant] tables; parts are [data-uifa-slot] hooks. Literal values are allowed only in theme dialect CSS inside the uif-themes layer, scoped under [data-theme] and targeting kit hooks and classes.

## Actions

- button | Button | Primary, secondary, danger, and compact action buttons with disabled, hover, and focus states. | data-uifa-variant: primary* / secondary / danger / small | behavior: none | docs: docs/components/button.md | src: items/button/

## Forms

- filter-bar | Filter bar | Search input plus toggleable filter chips with pressed states. | data-uifa-variant: none | behavior: none | docs: docs/components/filter-bar.md | src: items/filter-bar/
- form-field | Form field | Label, text input, and textarea with an accent focus ring. | data-uifa-variant: text* / textarea | behavior: none | docs: docs/components/form-field.md | src: items/form-field/
- segmented-control | Segmented control | Radio-group segment selector with selected and unselected states; keyboard navigable without JavaScript. | data-uifa-variant: none | behavior: css-only | docs: docs/components/segmented-control.md | src: items/segmented-control/
- toggle | Toggle switch | Switch-style checkbox with on, off, and disabled states. | data-uifa-variant: none | behavior: css-only | docs: docs/components/toggle.md | src: items/toggle/

## Content

- badge | Badge | Small status label: accent, ok, warn, danger, and muted outline variants. | data-uifa-variant: accent* / ok / warn / danger / muted | behavior: none | docs: docs/components/badge.md | src: items/badge/
- card | Card | Flat surface card with one radius and theme-defined shadow character. | data-uifa-variant: none | behavior: none | docs: docs/components/card.md | src: items/card/
- chip | Chip | Pill-radius tag for filters and metadata: neutral, accent, and warn variants. | data-uifa-variant: neutral* / accent / warn | behavior: none | docs: docs/components/chip.md | src: items/chip/
- code-block | Code block | Snippet surface with an optional filename header and a copy-to-clipboard button. | data-uifa-variant: labeled* / bare | behavior: js-inline | docs: docs/components/code-block.md | src: items/code-block/
- link-row | Link row | Title link with url line, chips, and an actions cluster; hover state on the row. | data-uifa-variant: none | behavior: none | docs: docs/components/link-row.md | src: items/link-row/
